title: Male Colored Figures with Hair
author: artbylin
description:
This croquis builder pack contains a male straight figure rendered in 3 skin tones (Light, Medium, Dark). Additionally, the figures come with 6 pre-drawn hairstyles in 5 hair colors (Black, Auburn, Brown, Sand, Blonde). The figures can be used for digital fashion illustration (eg. Procreate drawing on iPad).
You will also receive a layered Master File (Adobe Illustrator format) that contains all the skin tones, hairstyles and hair colors. Play around by toggling the visibility of layers on and off. There are a total of 90 variations. 
————————————————————————
4 FOLDERS + 1 MASTER FILE INCLUDED:
– FOLDER 1: Light-skinned individual figures (straight pose, front view) in Letter size (8.5 x 11 inches) & Legal size (11 x 14 inches), PNG format
– FOLDER 2: Medium-skinned individual figures in Letter & Legal size, PNG format
– FOLDER 3: Dark-skinned individual figures in Letter & Legal size, PNG format
– FOLDER 4: Monochrome line drawings of figures with 6 hairstyles in Letter & Legal size, PNG format
– MASTER FILE: All skin tones, hairstyles and hair colors on separate layers, Adobe Illustrator format (vector)
The vector format will allow you to re-size the figures in Adobe Illustrator without losing detail. Please note that the figures are done in my own style and may not conform to other fashion proportions.
